body:
Founder real-time: 'add a timer - 2.5 minutes - if time expires it's a draw and thats counted the same as a loss in terms of negative reward.' New MATCH_TIME_LIMIT_TICKS=9000 (150s at the real, confirmed 60Hz tick rate) caps every BrawlpitPacketEnv episode; compute_reward's new timed_out param applies REWARD_LOSS for both sides on timeout, never REWARD_WIN for whoever was ahead. rl_evaluate.py/rl_bot_pool.py's own max_ticks defaults now reference the same canonical constant (previously an arbitrary, much shorter 1800) and score a timeout as a real 0.5 Elo draw. 5 new tests, 107/107 total pass; live-verified against a real running bin/brawlpit_server with the limit overridden small -- episode ended via the real UDP wire protocol at exactly the configured tick with a real negative terminal reward.

⚓ ☃
title: S429: real 2.5-minute match time limit, timeout scored the same as a loss
